units.source_text: 这位天才出生于中国，长期旅居日本，仿佛是得天独厚的象征。

en.t: This genius was born in China and lived for many years in Japan, as if he were a symbol of extraordinary natural favor.

units.source_text: 吴六段的天才能发挥，是因为他到日本来了。

en.t: Wu Sixth Dan was able to develop his genius because he came to Japan.

units.source_text: 有一技之长的邻国人在日本受到敬重，例子并不算少。

en.t: There are more than a few cases of people from neighboring countries with a special skill being respected in Japan.

units.source_text: 眼前最生动的例子就是吴六段。

en.t: The most vivid example before us is Wu Sixth Dan himself.

units.source_text: 在中国可能被埋没的天才，在日本得到了培养、爱护和优厚的待遇。

en.t: A genius who might have been buried in obscurity in China was nurtured, cherished, and generously treated in Japan.

units.source_text: 这位少年天才是游历中国的日本棋手发现的。

en.t: This young genius was discovered by a Japanese go player traveling through China.

units.source_text: 他在中国时已学习日本棋书。

en.t: While he was still in China, he had already studied Japanese books on go.

units.source_text: 我觉得中国围棋的历史远比日本悠久，它的智慧在这位少年身上放射出了光芒。

en.t: I feel that the history of Chinese go is far older than Japan's, and that its wisdom shone forth through this boy.

units.source_text: 只是他背后这股强大的光源沉沦在深深的泥土里。

en.t: Only, the powerful source of light behind him lay sunk deep in the soil.

units.source_text: 尽管如此，倘使幼年时代没有机会进行磨炼，他的才华也就无法发挥，终将被埋没。

en.t: Even so, if he had had no chance to be tempered in childhood, his talent could never have come into play and would eventually have been buried.

units.source_text: 就是现今的日本，昙花一现的棋才也并不罕见。

en.t: Even in Japan today, go talents who flare up briefly and vanish are not uncommon.

units.source_text: 无论是对个人还是对民族来说，人的能力常常会遭遇这种命运。

en.t: Whether for an individual or for a people, human ability often meets with this kind of fate.

units.source_text: 一个民族的智慧，过去光辉灿烂，现在略为减弱；或是过去到现在一直被埋没，将来却一定会发挥出来，这种例子肯定也很多。

en.t: There must also be many cases in which the wisdom of a people once shone brilliantly and has now dimmed a little, or has remained buried from the past into the present but will surely reveal itself in the future.
